title: mcpDefs
description: MCP parameters for an entity type. The file name is the entity type.

features.description: Overrides feature availability for the entity type. If not defined, a feature is available for object entity types.

fields.description: Field parameters. Keys are field names.

featureAvailability.description: Whether the feature is available for the entity type.

mandatory.description: The field is always present in all actions, regardless of the fields selected in features. Not available for selection in the UI.

select.description: The 'select' action. Find feature, fields that can be selected.

filter.description: The 'filter' action. Find feature, fields that can be used in `where`.

read.description: The 'read' action. Read feature, fields that can be selected.

create.description: The 'create' action. Create feature, fields that can be written.

update.description: The 'update' action. Update feature, fields that can be written.

schemaProviderClassName.description: A field schema provider class. Overrides the one defined for the field type in app.mcpSchema.fieldTypes. Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\Schema\Field\SchemaProvider`.

filterSchemaProviderClassName.description: A field filter schema provider class. Overrides the one defined for the field type in app.mcpSchema.fieldTypes. Should implement `Espo\Modules\Mcp\Tools\Schema\FieldFilter\SchemaProvider`.

anyOf.description: The field is always present in the action, regardless of the fields selected in features.
The field is excluded from the action, even if mandatory or selected in a feature.
